name: io.github.VibeTechnologies/vibe-mcp
title: Vibe MCP — Real Chrome, Remotely
description: Drive your real, logged-in Chrome from any MCP client — even from a remote machine, no inbound port.

session_id.description: Your personal agent-connection ID from the Vibe extension (Settings -> external agent control -> Remote (internet) -> Agent connection URL). It is a bearer capability granting full control of that browser: never share it, and regenerate the session in the extension to revoke it.
